origin.usage: nzchar_ctl(x, keepNA = FALSE, ctl = "all", warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE))

arguments.name: keepNA
arguments.text: TRUE returns NA for a missing string. FALSE returns TRUE.

origin.details: TRUE when any non-control character remains. A missing string is TRUE unless keepNA is TRUE.

arguments.name: keepNA
arguments.text: TRUE returns NA for a missing string. FALSE returns TRUE.

translation.details: TRUE when any non-control character remains. A missing string is TRUE unless keepNA is TRUE. A string is a length-one vector, and None is a missing string.
translation.example:
from fansi import nzchar_ctl
print("nzchar_ctl(controls) returns %s." % nzchar_ctl("\n\x1b[42;31m\x1b[123P\a")[0])
